hypothesis: The causal near-ATM put-call implied-vol skew of the OTHER underlying (cross-asset skew spillover) has a positive monotone (Spearman rank) relationship with the subsequent forward realized return kurtosis (fourth standardized moment) of the target underlying, independent of any trading wrapper; tested on real on-disk captures at the composed EVAL-71 + alignment floor.
extends: EVAL-132 (cross-asset skew spillover signal verbatim) + EVAL-117/119/121/129 (forward realized return kurtosis target verbatim) + EVAL-71 (surface floor) + EVAL-77 (cross-asset alignment) + EVAL-65 (permutation / bootstrap inference) + EVAL-62 (FDR / seed); distinct cell: cross-asset skew spillover -> forward realized return kurtosis

protocol.title: Cross-asset near-ATM put-call implied-vol spillover (other asset's skew) -> forward own-asset realized return kurtosis predictiveness (Spearman rank IC)

cross_section.spillover_signal: signal_k = skew[OTHER](k)  (other asset's near-ATM put-call skew)

protocol.signal: causal per-bar near-ATM put-call implied-vol skew of the OTHER underlying (e71.build_surface_bars skew), aligned to the common BTC-vs-ETH bar grid (build_cross_section), forward-filled and expanding-zscored end-of-bar k (reused e71._forward_fill / e61.expanding_zscore)
protocol.target_detail: forward realized return kurtosis = m4 / m2**2 over the TARGET underlying's next H perp log returns (strictly after the decision at bar k, lr[k:k+h]); fourth standardized moment, transcribed verbatim from sealed EVAL-117/119/121/129
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(other_skew_z_k, own_kurt_k); directional permutation H1: IC>0 (wider other-asset near-ATM put-call skew -> fatter forward return tails on the target)
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH and at least one config, Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).

Below the floor the campaign seals BLOCKED, never NO-GO. This is NOT the EVAL-64 ladder floor.
